scope: E37-A only initially; frozen E29 seeds17/29, 288 dev events each, original Uniform16 Risk/Medium512; no training/new QKV/raw KV reads/Test.
weight: Pre-fixed summary mass squared: w=m^2. For each query, weighted LS intercept b=sum(w*(true_beta-pred_beta))/sum(w). Stable softmax(2logmass) within group, no ridge or clipping, no gain tuning.
groups: Candidate C is unique union of original16 removals and32 additions (48 pages); background complement. Fixed across five counterfactual states. Recompute all set aggregates after beta substitution.
evaluation: M16 actual queries only for scoring; trueQ64 cached gains for evaluation. Same-info Set and Independent. Per-query scalar fits on true labels are offline teachers. Full64 errors optionally diagnostic only.
gate: Both seeds: A2 recovers >=50% of E29 to TrueBeta executed Oracle-recovery gap; actual gain improves; degraded count strictly decreases, P10 and worst absolute NMSE increase no worse, mean relative gain no worse. No grid/extra groups. Only after this gate consider B; Test stays sealed.
variance: Mass-squared SSE decomposed per query: shared explained, extra candidate/background contrast explained, within-group remainder. Report global raw mass-squared sums and event/query-balanced shares separately; candidate/background weighted mean, centered variance, MSE, bias. Also unweighted beta MAE/RMSE; do not identify regression improvement with decision improvement.
